shared_elements: multi-tiered layered wing feathers behind the figure
raised/extended arm holding a small conical or pail-like object
horizontal band of inscription-like signs along the top edge
curled, ordered rows of hair/beard curls
profile eye and head facing left
relief panel with figure occupying nearly the whole field
justification: Both depict the same distinctive composite being \u2014 a winged humanoid in strict profile facing left, with tiered rows of stylized feathers, tightly curled hair rendered as beaded rows, and an outstretched arm carrying a small cone/vessel \u2014 beneath a horizontal band of inscribed signs, a highly specific and conventional combination unlikely to arise independently. The main differences are that A shows the whole standing figure with a bucket and an adjacent stylized rosette-bearing tree while B shows only a raptor-headed version cropped to head, shoulder and wings, with no tree visible.
